2) Any additional identifiers (user IDs, message hashes) to help locate copies in backups.

- For backups/snapshots we will provide a remediation plan and ETA after an initial scan (typically 48–72 hours).

I've looped in Monica (CS lead) to coordinate the operational steps and compliance communications. Monica — can you take point on the internal ticket and confirm the checklist?
